To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the community answers more questions and the search engine answers more questions correctly.
search engines are best at answering fact questions and online health communities best at answering value questions.
the online health community answers more questions than search results, but the answers from community members are not always clinically valid.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the quality of health information that patients encounter on the Internet and how to improve it.
the question types people ask online and what kinds of information sources are the most effective in answering those questions.
understanding the types of questions people ask about their health online and the strengths and weaknesses in the answers that people encounter.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

search results are the most clinically valid source for fact questions and the most effective source for value questions; community responses are the most effective source of answers for policy questions.
search results are more effective in answering value and fact questions and community responses are more effective in policy questions, but that both sources have their strengths and limitations.

the Internet is an important source of health information and that people should be aware that the information available on the web may not always be accurate and may not always be applicable to their specific situations.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
people should use the community responses to answer their value questions, use the search results for fact questions, and use both sources for policy questions.
search engines and online communities are both valuable resources for finding information on the Internet.
people are most likely to receive an answer to a question they ask online, but the answer may or may not be correct.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the Internet can provide answers for people's questions.
people need to be aware that different types of information are best suited to answer different types of questions.
people should not rely solely on search results when seeking health information online.
